Name: BVG Quail and Turkeys
Author: i24KittyKat
Description:
[center][size=5]Installation[/size][/center]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]
[*] Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25028]Mizu's Quail[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25071]Mizu's Turkey[/url] and unzip into your mods folder
[*] Download the main .zip file from this mod into the mod folder
[*] (Optional) Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry mod[/url]
[*] (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods﻿
[/list]
[center][size=5]Thanks[/size][/center]
Big thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/about-me?gameId=1303]MizuJakkaru[/url] for allowing me to make BVG variants of your birbs!~
